# CascadeTech Solutions

CascadeTech Solutions is an engineering and digital product innovation firm specializing in enterprise software, applied AI systems, custom web architecture, and multi-tenant cloud platforms.

## Flagship Products

### 1. Educore ERP (Multi-Tenant School Operating System)
- URL: https://www.cascade-erp.in/educore
- Overview: An enterprise-grade multi-tenant school ERP engineered with statutory compliance for India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.
- Core Capabilities:
  - 100% DPDP Act 2023 statutory consent workflows & zero-trust isolation
  - Double-entry automated school fee management & fee-drift prevention
  - EPFO ECR text format export & payroll engine
  - Automated CBSE report cards & student attendance
  - Multi-role dashboards: Super Admin, School Principal, Teachers, Accountants, Parents, Students

### 2. Nestora Hub (Real Estate & Property Discovery Ecosystem)
- URL: https://www.cascade-erp.in/nestorahub
- Overview: Next-generation property discovery platform connecting buyers, sellers, and tenants with verified property listings across North Karnataka.
- Core Capabilities:
  - Sub-second search indexing and smart property filters
  - 500+ verified residential and commercial listings
  - Direct inquiry turnaround within 2 hours
  - Interactive map integration and virtual tour scheduling

### 3. GovOS (Multi-Tenant Civic Governance Operating System)
- URL: https://www.cascade-erp.in/govos
- Overview: A browser-based Web OS shell providing elected representatives, municipal officers, and citizens with a unified real-time governance and civic service delivery layer.
- Core Capabilities:
  - Multi-tenant architecture (MTAS) with complete data isolation for municipalities and urban local bodies
  - 11 integrated civic modules: Complaints, Public Works, Ward Mapping, and Departmental MIS
  - Statutory India DPDP Act 2023 compliance & encrypted citizen PII vaults
  - Real-time WebSocket event bridge with multi-channel SMS/WhatsApp alerts
  - Grievance SLA turnaround under 24 hours with 99.2% citizen satisfaction index
